title: Prefix Count via Trie
statement: Read n, then n words (one per line), then a prefix string. Build a trie (prefix tree) from the n words and print how many of the words start with the given prefix (an exact match to the prefix itself also counts).
starter_code:
n = int(input())
words = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
prefix = input().strip()

# TODO: insert all `words` into a trie (nested dict or a small Node class
# with a per-node pass-through counter), then walk the trie along
# `prefix` and print how many inserted words pass through that node.
# If the prefix path doesn't exist in the trie at all, print 0.
hints: Give each trie node a counter that increments every time a word passes through it during insertion
To answer a prefix query, walk the trie character by character along the prefix; if you fall off the trie, the answer is 0, otherwise it's the counter at the final node
